from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

# Define correct qubit/clbit dimensions based on the user request
num_qubits = 4
num_clbits = 4
qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_clbits)

# Step 1: Apply H gate to all qubits 0, 1, 2, 3
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

# Step 2: Apply Rz(2.5453) to qubit 0, Rz(0.1745) to qubit 1, Rz(2.9512) to qubit 2, Rz(2.7672) to qubit 3
qc.rz(2.5453, 0)
qc.rz(0.1745, 1)
qc.rz(2.9512, 2)
qc.rz(2.7672, 3)

# Step 3: Apply CNOT(0,1), then Rz(3.5386) to qubit 1, then CNOT(0,1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(3.5386, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Step 4: Apply CNOT(1,2), then Rz(1.1299) to qubit 2, then CNOT(1,2)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.1299, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

# Step 5: Apply CNOT(2,3), then Rz(0.1426) to qubit 3, then CNOT(2,3)
qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.1426, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 6: Repeat Steps 1-5 exactly once more (second ZZ layer)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

qc.rz(2.5453, 0)
qc.rz(0.1745, 1)
qc.rz(2.9512, 2)
qc.rz(2.7672, 3)

qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(3.5386, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.1299, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.1426, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 7: Measure qubits 0,1,2,3 using qc.measure([0,1,2,3],[0,1,2,3])
qc.measure([0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2, 3])
